subject.why: The wishing well is instantly recognizable and includes the roof, bucket, and requested flower accents.

category.why: It sits firmly on a clear ground plane with a low camera angle and simplified environment.

clean.why: The image is free of characters, UI elements, text, and borders.

framing.why: The structure is centered with a solid silhouette and adequate breathing room around the edges.

colour.why: Vibrant and saturated palette with good contrast against the bright blue sky.

detail.why: Shapes remain chunky and stylized without cluttered textures or excessive micro-details.

style.why: Matches the reference art with smooth bevels, satin lighting, and clean 3D volumes.
